Loading in tidyverse

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load hg19 and hg16 into the same combined data frame

```{r}
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
hg19 <- read_tsv("hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )
hg16 <- read_tsv("hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names=header)
# combine into new dataframe 
combined_df <- bind_rows( hg19=hg19, hg16=hg16, .id="assembly" )
```

Visualize both hg19 and hg16 onto the same line plot

```{r}
ggplot(combined_df, aes( x = start, y = count, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free")

ggsave("exercise2.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 10)
```
